info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Triggers API
Microsoft Windows 10 List available trigger types

items.docs: Retrieves the list of available background task trigger types including SystemTrigger, TimeTrigger, MaintenanceTrigger, PushNotificationTrigger, LocationTrigger, BluetoothLEAdvertisementWatcherTrigger, DeviceUseTrigger, and ActivitySensorTrigger.
